preconditions.description: The number of vertices n must be between 2 and 100,000.
The number of ants m must be between 1 and 10,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u_i <= n and 1 <= v_i <= n for u_i, v_i in edges)
preconditions.description: All edges must connect vertices within the range of 1 to n.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= n and 1 <= b_i <= n and 1 <= c_i <= n and 1 <= d_i <= n for a_i, b_i, c_i, d_i in ants)
preconditions.description: All favorite pairs for ants must be valid vertices within the range of 1 to n.

preconditions.expression: all(a_i != b_i and c_i != d_i for a_i, b_i, c_i, d_i in ants)
preconditions.description: Each ant's favorite pairs must not contain the same vertex.

postconditions.description: If it is impossible to paint the edges, output 'NO'. Otherwise, output 'YES' followed by m lines indicating the chosen pairs for each ant.

postconditions.expression: all(output_lines[i] in {'1', '2'} for i in range(m))
postconditions.description: Each line of output must contain either '1' or '2' indicating the chosen pair for each ant.
